title: Off the shelf
sub: The opening film of a series on data governance: a new governance lead inherits a shelf of policies, two numbers that disagree, and the question every policy has to answer: where does it run?
howto: The university is a toy town: rooms open at the front, people on small bases. A gold rim marks the business side, a blue rim the technical side, plain walnut the people of the past. Gold is governance's decisions.
